verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Okta exposes an MCP server so external AI agents can query/act on Okta admin data (e.g., failed logins, unused apps), and a Cross App Access playground for agent-to-app auth, but there is no evidence of Okta itself surfacing AI-generated insights, anomaly detection, or proactive suggestions natively inside its own product UI. This is agent-tooling for external consumption, not in-product AI insight generation.
